title: The sock cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the sock. Chewed. Alone on the floorboards. The owner says it's a sock. Wood says it's the first leash. She says it's a sock. He says it's the same thing. She says only to the dog. He says the dog's the one who'd know.

panels.composition: The cover: a chewed sock on floorboards, drawn with the care of a portrait.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a single chewed sock on wooden floorboards drawn with great care, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

a laundromat owner, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The rack. The sock facing the room. The dog in the doorway looking at his own sock on a cover, unmoved. He'd know.
